title: Fix cancellation token propagation gaps across middleware and services
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
- **3 instances** in `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemorySmithRequestGuardMiddleware.cs` (L35, L42, L49) — `context.RequestAborted` not passed to downstream async methods
- **2 instances** in `MemorySmith.App/Services/Training/TrainingHarnessRunnerService.cs` (L93, L94) — `cancellationToken` parameter not forwarded

## Impact
Cancelled HTTP requests and training operations continue processing unnecessarily, wasting server resources and potentially causing inconsistent state on shutdown.

## Action Required
1. Pass `context.RequestAborted` to each async method call in `RequestGuardMiddleware`
2. Forward the `cancellationToken` parameter in `TrainingHarnessRunnerService`

## Effort
~5min

## Priority
P0 — Reliability/Bug
